https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: acid
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: substance that yields hydrogen ions or protons in aqueous solutions; a substance capable of accepting a pair of electrons for the formation of a coordinate covalent bond; a substance whose hydrogen can be replaced by metals or basic radicals, or which react with bases to form salts and water

annotations.example: An example of an acid is hydrochloric acid.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: active ingredient
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: ingredient present in a currently or previously marketed drug product indicating that it is or becomes pharmacologically active once delivered to patients

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: active moiety role
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: role of the part of a molecule responsible for the physiological or pharmacological action of the substance

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: additive ingredient
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: role of an inactive ingredient that is any additive in the product

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: adjuvant
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: ingredient that potentiates the immune response to an antigen and/or modulates it towards the desired immune response

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: agent modification method
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: method of a modification by means of an agent where the chemical modifications are diverse or unclear

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: agent modification type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for modifications whereby the chemical modifications are diverse or unclear, specifying the type of agent caused the modification

annotations.example: chemical, enzymatic, immunological, organism, UV radiation

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: amount
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: characteristic that quantifies the absolute or relative mass, volume or other quantity of something

annotations.example: the relative mass of material of a specific substance in a mixture

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: amount type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifies and denotes some quantity and states how a numeric amount is to be interpreted

annotations.example: Exact (the default, when not specified); Approximate; NLT; NMT

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: analysis
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: process of determining the constituency of matter

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: analytical method
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: method or procedure for performing some analysis

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: atom
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: smallest particle characterizing a chemical element

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: author
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: role of a party responsible for the creation of a publication, document, or of research, including data

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: author type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for a party responsible for the creation of a publication, document, or of research, including data

annotations.example: Species parenthetical author, Species primary author

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: base
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: substance having an available pair of electrons capable of forming a covalent bond with a hydron or with the vacant orbital of some other molecular entity

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: base ingredient
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: role of an inactive ingredient that is the base of a preparation

annotations.example: water, vaseline, ethanol

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: chemical element
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: chemical substance comprised of atoms with the same atomic number

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: chemical substance
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: single substance that can be described as a stoichiometric or non-stoichiometric single molecular entity and is not a protein, nucleic acid or polymer substance

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: color ingredient
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: role of an inactive ingredient added to alter the color appearance

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: conformance level
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier that describes whether an element is required for a given substance type or a specified substance group

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: contaminant ingredient
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: role of an inactive ingredient whose presence is not intended but may not be reasonably avoided given the circumstances of the mixture's nature or origin

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: copolymer connectivity
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier specifying the copolymer sequence type (polymer connectivity), which can either be random, statistical, alternating, periodic, block, graft or mixed, typically describing the manner in which the SRUs (structural repeat units) connect to each other

annotations.example: random, alternating, block, graft, statistical, periodic, mixed, cross, N/A

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: degree of polymerization
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier specifying the average number of monomers or repeat units in a polymeric block or chain

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: degree of polymerization code
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: concept descriptor denoting the degree, within a block, of polymerization for a homopolymer or block copolymer

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: development stage
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier representing the period of life of an animal, plant, algae, fungi, insect or micro-organism, characterized by growth pattern, behavior, and other milesones

annotations.example: foetus, infant, juvenile, adult, senescent, leafing, pre-flowering, flowering, fruiting, mature development stage, mature animal

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: element group
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: collection of aspects or sub-specifications in a specified substance group

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: ester
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: substance formally derived from an oxoacid RkE(=O)l(OH)m (l > 0) and an alcohol, phenol, heteroarenol, or enol by linking with formal loss of water from an acidic hydroxy group of the former and a hydroxy group of the latter

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: excipient
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: pharmacological role of a generally pharmacologically inactive substance that is formulated with the active ingredient of a medication

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: flavor ingredient
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: role of an inactive ingredient added to alter the taste of the product

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: gene
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: basic unit of hereditary information composed of chains of nucleotide base pairs in specific sequences that encodes a protein or protein subunit

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: gene element
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: individual element within a gene such as a promoter, enhancer, silencer or coding sequence

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: gene element identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: unique identifier for a gene element

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: gene element name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specific name given for a gene element

annotations.example: SV40 Enhancer

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: gene element type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for the gene element

annotations.example: enhancer, promoter, silencer, terminator, repressor, epimerase, polymerase linker, transferase, capsule transporter, synthase, synthetase

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: gene identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: unique identifier associated with the gene of origin

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: gene name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: complete name given for a gene

annotations.example: hIL-10 gene

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: gene sequence origin
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: common name for the organism from which the final gene sequence originated

annotations.example: Human, Bovine, Human, Humanized, Mouse-Human Chimeric, Mouse, Bacterial, Viral, Plant, Arachnid

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: genus
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: taxonomic category ranking below a family (or subfamily) and above a species and generally consisting of a group of species exhibiting similar characteristics

annotations.example: Ginkgo; Harpagophytum

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: glycosylation
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: description of an enzymatic process that links saccharides or oligosaccharides to substances, specifying the type and sites of post-translational modification involving the addition of glycosyl radicals to a protein or structurally diverse substance

annotations.example: Examples of glycosylation types include fungal, plant, anthropoid, avian, mammalian and human.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: glycosylation type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for the glycan, specified based on a controlled vocabulary, that differentiates among the significant differences in glycosylation between different types of organisms

annotations.example: human, old world monkey, mammalian, avian, reptilian, fungal, bacterial, plant, insect, mammalian afucosylated, yeast humanized

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: hybrid organism
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: offspring resulting from combining the qualities of two organisms of different varieties, species, or genera

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: hybrid type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier specifying the type of hybridization, based on a controlled vocabulary, if known

annotations.example: hybrid unknown lineage, hybrid known lineage

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: hydrate
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: addition compound (substance) that contains water in weak chemical combination with another compound

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: IUPAC International Chemical Identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specification for a linear, layered representation of a chemical structure, comprised of up to four layers: (1) constitutional - expresses pure connectivity of the atoms, (2) stereochemical - includes conventional C-atom sp2 and sp3 stereochemistry, (3) isotopic - enables isotopes to be distinguished, and (4) tautomeric - implements simple forms of rapid H-migration isomerization

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: IUPAC International Chemical Identifier Key
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specification for a fixed length (25 characters) condensed digital representation of an InChI

annotations.example: The InChI for formaldehyde is InChI=1S/CH2O/c1-2/h1H2 and the InChIKey WSFSSNUMVMOOMR-UHFFFAOYSA-N

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: inactive ingredient
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: ingredient of a given formulation (most frequently, an excipient) that does not exhibit pharmacological activity

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: inactive moiety role
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: role of an inactive portion of a molecule or substance, i.e., one that that does not exhibit pharmacological activity

annotations.example: Examples include the appended portions of the molecule that cause the drug to be an ester, salt (including a salt with hydrogen or coordination bonds), or other noncovalent derivative (such as a complex, chelate, or clathrate) of the molecule.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: ingredient
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: role of a substance that is specifically part of or used in the preparation of some manufactured item, pharmaceutical product, medication, or drug

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: interaction type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for the kind(s) of interactions that may occur between a substance and its target

annotations.example: AGONIST, INDUCER, INHIBITOR, PARTIAL ANTAGONIST, SUBSTRATE, PRODUCT

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: intraspecific type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: taxonomic category ranking below species

annotations.example: cv. (cultivar), var. (variety), serotype, strain, subsp. (subspecies); cell line; year of isolation

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: isotope
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: variant of a chemical substance comprised solely of atoms with the same atomic number, that differs by atomic mass, having the same number of protons and differing in the number of neutrons in the nucleus

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: isotope composition
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: constituency of a substance in terms of nuclides being present

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: isotopic substitution
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: replacement of an atom by a specific nuclide

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: isotopic substitution classifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for an isotopic substitution by site of substitution

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: kingdom
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: highest taxonomic rank, immediately above phylum or division

annotations.example: Plantae

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: linkage
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: connection between sugar residues

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: manufactured item
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specification for a good that embodies the qualitative and quantitative composition of a product as contained in the packaging of the medicinal product

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: manufacturer
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: functional role of a party that produces finished products from raw materials or components using tools, machinery, labor, and chemical or physical transformation

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: manufacturer identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: unique identifier (code) for the role of a legal entity that produces finished products from raw materials or components thereof

annotations.example: DUNS86745HF (Artificial ID)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: manufacturer name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: designation for the role of a legal entity that produces finished products from raw materials or components thereof

annotations.example: Company ABC, (Address, Geographical coordinates)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: market context
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: context that reflects a group of people with some shared characteristics that an organization has identified as potential customers for for a substance or product

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: material
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: entity that has mass, occupies space and consists of one or more substances

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: material classifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for substances or specified substances of which certain products, packaging, or devices are made

annotations.example: biological material

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: material component
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: material that is part of some multi-substance material

annotations.example: Dimethicone and silicon dioxide are components of simethicone. Human insulin and protamine are the components in human insulin isophane.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: material component classifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for components of some material

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: material component specification
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specification of a component or part of a material

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: material identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: unique identifier for substances or specified substances of which certain products, packaging, or devices are made

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: material name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: designation for a substance or specified substance of which certain products, packaging, or devices are made

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: material role
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: functional role played by a material that is part of or used in the preparation of some manufactured item, or pharmaceutical product, medication, or drug

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: material specification
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specification for substances or specified substances that are part of or used in the preparation of some manufactured item, or pharmaceutical product, medication, or drug

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: matter
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: something that has mass and occupies space by virtue of having volume

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: mechanical ingredient
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: role of an inactive ingredient which, as a whole, lends a spatial structure to the product, which structure is meaningful to the delivery of the pharmacologically active ingredients near the target site

annotations.example: For example, a collagen matrix used as a base for transplanting skin cells.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: mixture
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: polydisperse substance that is a combination of single substances isolated together or produced in the same synthetic process

annotations.example: Gentamicin is defined as a mixture substance of Gentamicin C1, Gentamicin C1A, Gentamicin C2, Gentamicin C2A and Gentamicin C2B. Glyceryl monoesters are defined as mixture substances of two single substances which differ in the position of esterification. Simethicone, which consists of dimethicone and silicon dioxide, is not defined as a mixture substance since these are diverse materials brought together to form a multi-substance material.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: mixture type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for the mixture

annotations.example: all of; one of; any of

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: modification
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: process that changes the constituency, structure or a characteristic of matter, while retaining the essential characteristics of the matter with regards to its identity

annotations.example: Structural modifications are used to describe in principle covalent modifications or essential associations of moieties with a protein, nucleic acid, or structurally diverse material. Covalent modification for a protein, nucleic acid or structurally diverse material typically means an amino acid substitution, a C-/N-terminal modification of a protein or base or 5'-, 3'- modifications of nucleic acids. The tight and/or stoichiometric association of moieties to macromolecular material by ionic forces, chelate formation, van der Waals interactions, or dipole moment interactions are also considered structural modifications since they may affect the tertiary structure of the protein/peptide or are an essential element of the drug substance (e.g. a chelated radionuclide). When peptide or nucleic acid chains are tightly associated either through covalent bonds or strong non-covalent interactions (e.g. Factor VIII: Von-Willebrand Factor interactions, Watson-Crick base pairing) they will be described as subunits of the respective protein or nucleic acid.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: modification agent
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: something that acts as an agent in the modification of another substance

annotations.example: A chemical, an enzyme, an organism or UV radiation can play this role.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: modification method
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specification of a substance modification

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: modification method type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for the method of modification

annotations.example: structural modification, agent modification, physical modification

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: modification role
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: function of the modification of the substance

annotations.example: antigen, linker, conjugate, inactivation, antigen priming, end-cap polymerization, sizing of polysaccharide into oligosaccharides, inactivation of antigen to reduce allergenicity

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: modification role code
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code for the function of a modification

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: moiety
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: entity within a substance that has a complete and continuous molecular structure

annotations.example: The strength of a medicinal product is often based on what is referred to as the active moiety of the molecule, responsible for the physiological or pharmacological action of the drug substance. To avoid ambiguity, the free acid and/or free base should be used as the moiety upon which strength is based.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: moiety identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: unique identifier for an entity within a substance that has a complete and continuous molecular structure

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: moiety name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: name or company code associated with the moiety

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: moiety role
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: functional role played by a moiety in some substance or product

annotations.example: counter-ion, solvate, hydrate, parent, base, acid, co-crystallizing agent

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: molecular composition
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: constituency of a substance in terms of its molecular entities

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: molecular constituent
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: scattered molecular entities of the same type that make up the constituency of a substance at the molecular level

annotations.example: Acid substances consist of molecules that play the role of an acid.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: molecular entity
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: constitutionally or isotopically distinct atom, molecule, ion, ion pair, radical, radical ion, complex, conformer etc., identifiable as a separately distinguishable entity

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: molecular formula
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: chemical formula that shows the total number and kind of atoms in a molecule indicating atomic proportional ratios (the numerical proportions of atoms of one type to those of other types) which is a way of expressing information about the proportions of atoms that constitute a particular chemical compound, using a single line of chemical element symbols, numbers, and sometimes other symbols

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: molecular formula by moiety
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: way of describing of the molecular formula of a stoichiometric or non-stoichiometric substance existing of two or more moieties, the molecular formula of each moiety shall be described separated by a dot

annotations.example: The molecular formula of the chemical salt Amlodipine besilate is described as C20H25ClN2O5.C6H6O3S.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: molecular fragment
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: portion of a molecule that has one or more sites of attachment to other fragments or moieties

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: molecular fragment identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: unique identifier assigned to the substance representing the fragment based on the ISO 11238 substance controlled vocabulary

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: molecular fragment name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: official name of a molecular fragment

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: molecular fragment role
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: role of the molecular fragment that undergoes a modification

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: molecular graph
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: single chemical structure that is an unambiguous representation of the arrangement of atoms, normalized to conform with the International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry (IUPAC) specification for drawing chemical structures to the degree possible

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: molecular graph identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: unique identifier for a molecular graph representing a single chemical structure

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: molecular group
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: defined linked collection of atoms or a single atom within a molecular entity

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: molecular structure
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: unambiguous representation of the arrangement of atoms

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: molecular structure identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: unique identifier for the unambiguous representation of the arrangement of atoms for a given substance

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: molecular weight
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: mass of one molecule of a homogenous substance or the average mass of molecules that comprise a heterogeneous substance, which is derived from the molecular structure or the molecular formula

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: molecular weight method
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for the method used to determine molecular weight

annotations.example: SDS-PAGE (sodium dodecyl sulfate-polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis), calculated, light scattering, viscosity, gel permeation, end-group analysis, end-group titration, size-exclusion chromatography

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: molecular weight type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for the nature of the molecular weight

annotations.example: exact, average (also known as. number average), weight average

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: molecule
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: electrically neutral entity consisting of more than one atom (n>1)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: molfile
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specification for a widely used, non-linear chemical structure file format that includes: (1) a list of atoms, specifying the elemental identity of each atom, (2) a list of bonds, specifying the atoms that it connects and the bond multiplicity (single, double, triple), (3) 2D or 3D spatial coordinates for each atom, (4) counts of the number of atoms and bonds in the molecule, (5) attributes associated with the atoms or bonds (e.g. R/S configuration of a stereocenter; dashed/wedged bond, and (6) attributes associated with an entire structure (e.g. net charge).

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: monodisperse substance
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: single substance that is homogeneous in molecular weight, that is, it does not have a distribution of different molecular weight chains within the total mass

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: monomer amount type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier that indicates how the ratio of the monomer or the structural repeat unit (SRU) to the entire polymer is captured

annotations.example: Monomer/Polymer ratio, SRU/Polymer Ratio

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: monomer set description

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medical condition
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: condition that impairs the body's normal functioning or its parts and is characterized by specific symptoms and/or signs

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medical device
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specification of an instrument, apparatus, appliance, software, material or other article, whether used alone or in combination, including the software intended by its manufacturer to be used specifically for diagnostic and/or therapeutic purposes and necessary for its proper application, intended by the manufacturer to be used for human beings for the purpose of: — diagnosis, prevention, monitoring, treatment or alleviation of disease; — diagnosis, monitoring, treatment, alleviation of or compensation for an injury or handicap; — investigation, replacement or modification of the anatomy or of a physiological process; — control of conception, and which does not achieve its principal intended action in or on the human body by pharmacological, immunological or metabolic means, but which may be assisted in its function by such means

annotations.example: Some examples of devices in the context of pharmaceutical products are drug delivery systems, drug-eluting stents, insulin pumps, glucose meters, and diagnostic test kits.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medical device batch identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: unique identifier allocated to a specific batch of a medical device

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medical device material
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specification of the material(s) of which a given device is made

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medical device nomenclature
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: terminology structured systematically according to pre-established naming rules for medical devices

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medication
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: role of a substance or product that is used in the treatment of a disease or symptom

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medication classifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for a medication by active substance or medicinal product(s)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medication therapy
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: therapy in which a medication is administered to the patient

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medicinal product
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specification for a pharmaceutical product or combination of pharmaceutical products that may be administered to human beings (or animals) for treating or preventing disease, with the aim/purpose of making a medical diagnosis or to restore, correct or modify physiological functions

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medicinal product batch identifier for immediate packaging
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: unique identifier allocated to a specific batch of a medicinal product, which appears on the immediate packaging, where this is not the outer packaging

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medicinal product batch identifier for outer packaging
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: unique identifier allocated to a specific batch of a medicinal product, which appears on the outer packaging of the medicinal product

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medicinal product code segment
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code assigned to each package presentation of a medicinal product

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medicinal product container
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specification for a container that is part of a medicinal product and is used for storage, identification and/or transport of the components of the medicinal product or packaged medicinal product

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medicinal product cross-reference
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: reference to another medicinal product that bears some relationship with the medicinal product in question

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medicinal product header identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: unique identifier allocated to a specific version of a header [record], i.e., a record specifying the versioning of the core identifiers related to a medicinal product in a region, as well as the characteristics associated with the medicinal product and the documentation that supports the versioning

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medicinal product header record
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: record that specifies the versioning of the core identifiers related to a medicinal product in a region [jurisdiction], as well as the characteristics associated with the medicinal product and the documentation that supports the versioning

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medicinal product identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: unique identifier allocated to a medicinal product supplementary to any existing authorization number as ascribed by a medicines regulatory agency in a region

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medicinal product manufacturing process
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: process of production for a substance or medicinal product from the acquisition of all materials through all processing stages

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medicinal product master file
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: collection of records submitted to a medicines regulatory agency that may be used to provide confidential detailed information about facilities, processes, or articles used in the manufacturing, processing, packaging, and storing of one or more human drugs

annotations.example: Pharmacovigilance System Master File

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medicinal product master file holder
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: authorized role of a legal entity (organization) that holds a master file for a given medicinal product

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medicinal product monitoring indicator
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for medicinal products, specifying whether a given product is subject to additional monitoring

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medicinal product name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: name as authorized by a medicines regulatory agency

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medicinal product name locale
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: context in which a given medicinal product name applies

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: medicines regulatory agency
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: institutional body that, according to the legal system under which it has been established, is responsible for the granting of marketing authorizations, clinical trial authorizations and manufacturing authorizations for medicinal products

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: orphan designation
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for medicinal products, including drugs and biologics, that have orphan status, especially with respect to rare diseases and or populations that meet certain criteria

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: other product characteristic
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: aspect of a manufactured item, package item, or medical device that describes that product

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: other product characteristic code
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: value for an aspect of a manufactured item, package item, or medical device that describes that product, derived from a controlled vocabulary

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: other therapy specifics
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specification of the relationship between the indication or contraindication of a medicinal product with another therapy

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: package component
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specification of a part of a package item

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: package description code segment
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code assigned to each package presentation of a medicinal product

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: package identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: unique identifier allocated in addition to any existing authorisation/approval number at package level as ascribed by a Medicines Regulatory Agency in a region

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: package item
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specification for an individual, distinct item contained in a packaged medicinal product that acts as a container for one or more manufactured item(s)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: package item quantity
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: quantity (or count number) of the package item

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: package item type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for package items (containers)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: packaged medicinal product
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: medicinal product in a container being part of a package, representing the entirety that has been packaged for sale or supply

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: paediatric use indicator
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for medicinal products, specifying whether a given product is authorized for use in children

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: pharmaceutical dose form
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specification for the physical manifestation of a medicinal product that contains the active ingredient(s) and/or inactive ingredient(s) that are intended to be delivered to the patient

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: pharmaceutical product
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specification for the qualitative and quantitative composition of a medicinal product in the dose form approved for administration in line with the regulated product information

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: pharmaceutical product batch
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specific quantity of a drug or other material that is intended to have uniform character and quality, within specified limits, and is produced according to a single manufacturing order during the same cycle of manufacture

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: pharmaceutical product batch number
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: identifier assigned to a specific batch of a medicinal product or item resulting from a manufacturing process at a specific point of time

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: pharmaceutical product characteristic
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: aspect of a pharmaceutical product that describes that product, such as its onset of action

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: pharmaceutical product characteristic code
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: value for a specific pharmaceutical product characteristic value, derived from a controlled vocabulary

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: pharmaceutical product characteristic status
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for an aspect of a pharmaceutical product that describes that product, such as its onset of action, indicating the state of the characteristic in question

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: unique identifier for a pharmaceutical product

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: collection of identifiers associated with a given pharmaceutical product

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: physical medicinal product
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: pharmaceutical product or combination of pharmaceutical products that may be administered to human beings (or animals) for treating or preventing disease, with the aim/purpose of making a medical diagnosis or to restore, correct or modify physiological functions

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: physical medicinal product container
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: container that is part of a medicinal product and is used for storage, identification and/or transport of the components of the medicinal product

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: physical pharmaceutical product
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: qualitative and quantitative composition of a medicinal product in the dose form approved for administration in line with the regulated product information

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: physiological condition
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: condition or state of the external or internal milieu for an organism

annotations.example: Being in good health and being pregnant are physiological conditions but not necessarily medical conditions. Pregnancy can have complications that would be classified as medical conditions, however.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: physiological condition population characteristic
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for a statistical population based on the physiological condition of its members

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: placebo
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: inactive substance, treatment or procedure that is intended to provide baseline measurements for the experimental protocol of a clinical trial

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: population characteristic
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier of a target population intended as the target of a therapeutic indication or contraindication

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: presentation strength
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: quantity or range of quantities of the substance/specified substance present per unitary volume (or mass) expressed in units of presentation

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: process
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: structured set of activities involving various enterprise entities designed and organized for a given purpose

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: process identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: identifier assigned to a structured set of activities involving various enterprise entities, that is designed and organized for a given purpose

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: process specification
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specification for a structured set of activities involving various enterprise entities designed and organized for a given purpose

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: process step
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: part of a process that usually operates independently from other process stages and that usually results in a planned sequence of chemical or physical changes in the material being processed

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: process step identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: identifier assigned to a part of a process

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: product classifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for a product using a categorization or grouping of medicinal products based on specific properties

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: product composition
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: constituency that defines some product based on its relationship(s) to some other substance(s) (ingredient(s)), potentially with a given strength, in some context

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: product role
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: functional role played by a product or specification for a product that is part of or used in the preparation of some manufactured item, or pharmaceutical product, medication, or drug, or in some investigation

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: product specification
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specification for something that is produced by, results from, or obtained as a consequence of some process or transformation

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: qualitative composition
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: composition of all the constituents of the investigational or authorized medicinal product), if applicable, before or after reconstitution and functioning of the constituents of: - the substance (and specified substance description; - the excipients, whatever their nature or the quantity used, including colouring matter, preservatives, adjuvants, stabilizers, thickeners, emulsifiers, flavouring and aromatic substances, etc.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: quantitative composition
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: amount of substance and specified substance constituents of the investigational or authorized medicinal product expressed in a ratio scale

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: race or ethnicity
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: subdivision of human population based on common culture or descent or a subspecies of animals

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: race or ethnicity population characteristic
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for a statistical population based on the race or ethnicity of its members

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: reference strength
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: strength of an active substance(s) and/or specified substance(s) used as a reference from which the strength of an investigational or authorized medicinal product is described

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: registration number
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: identifier assigned to a clinical trial by a medicines regulatory agency in a region for tracking purposes

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: route of administration
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specification for the path by which the pharmaceutical product is taken into or makes contact with the body

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: route of administration code
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code for the path by which the pharmaceutical product is taken into or makes contact with the body

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: scoring
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for a debossed line that runs across the planar surface of a tablet

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: shape
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: morphological physical characteristic inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ratios of distances between its features (points, edges, surfaces and also holes etc).

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: shelf life
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: medicinal product classifier describing the period during which a medicinal product retains its properties and stated performance within specified limits if stored under defined conditions

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: shelf life type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for the period during which a medical product retains its properties and stated performance within specified limits if stored under defined conditions, taking into account various scenarios such as shelf life of the packaged medicinal product itself, shelf life after transformation where necessary, shelf life after first opening of a bottle, etc.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: small to medium enterprise
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier indicating that an entity has been certified based on its size in order to receive authorization for something under special rules

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: special precautions for storage
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier describing additional storage conditions for a medicinal product or package item, if any

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: sponsor
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: individual, company, institution or organization (party), which takes responsibility for the initiation, management and/or financing of a clinical trial

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: strength
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: quantity or range of quantities of the substance/specified substance present per unitary volume (or mass)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: symptom/condition/effect classification
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for the symptom, condition or effect that is undesirable effect

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: target population
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: collection of patients or consumers for which the indication of a medicinal product is authorized or is under investigation

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: therapeutic indication
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specification that defines the target disease or condition for which the medicinal product is authorized or under investigation

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: therapeutic indication text
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: textual description of the therapeutic indications of a medicinal product

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: therapy
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: action or administration of therapeutic agents to produce an effect that is intended to alter the course of a pathologic process

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: therapy relationship
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relationship that applies to a therapy or therapy specification

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: therapy relationship type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier for a the relationship to a therapy or therapy specification

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: undesirable effect
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specification of any potential undesirable side effect, adverse reaction or event, complication, or other similar potential consequence associated with the medicinal product as authorized or under investigation

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: undesirable effect text
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: textual description of an undesirable effect of a medicinal product

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: validity period
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: explicit time period of the marketing authorization for the relevant status

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: volume characteristic
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: 3-D extent physical characteristic inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's amount of 3-dimensional space it occupies

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: weight characteristic
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: physical characteristic inhering in a bearer that has mass near a gravitational body

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: width characteristic
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: 1-D extent physical characteristic which is equal to the distance from one side of an object to another side which is opposite

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: code system
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: managed collection of concept identifiers, usually codes, but sometimes more complex sets of rules and references

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: code system name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: common name of the coding system

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: coding rationale
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code element that indicates a reason why a particular CD has been provided, either as the root concept or as one of the translations.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: compression algorithm
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code element that identifies an algorithm, if any, used to compress the raw byte data

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: controlled vocabulary
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: finite set of values that represent the only allowed values for a data item

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: datatype flavor
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code element that describes a common constraint pattern on a datatype

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: entity name part type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code element that identifies a component of a name

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier that defines the basic properties of every data value

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier that stands for the values of two-valued logic

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: ISO 21090 boolean non-null datatype
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier that stands for the values of two-valued logic, for which a value is required

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: ISO 21090 character string
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier that stands for text data, primarily intended for machine processing (e.g. sorting, querying, indexing, etc.) or direct display

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: ISO 21090 concept descriptor
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier that provides a reference to a concept defined in an external code system, terminology or ontology

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier that provides the top-level, abstract definition of a datatype, which is set of distinct values, characterized by properties of those values, and by operations on those values, according to the ISO 20190 specification

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: ISO 21090 encapsulated data
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier that stands for data that are primarily intended for human interpretation or for further machine processing outside the scope of the ISO 21090 International Standard

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: ISO 21090 entity name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: designation by which someone, some place, or something is known in the context of ISO 21090

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: ISO 21090 entity name part
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier that defines the basic properties of component of an entity name

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code element that identifies the algorithm used to compute the IntegrityCheckAlgorithm value

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code element that provides a general framework for handling incomplete data which is often encountered in healthcare information collection, use and analysis

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: object identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: globally unique identifier of a data object as defined in ISO/IEC 8824-2

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: update mode
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code element that allows a sending system to identify the role that the attribute plays in processing the instance that is being represented

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: value domain
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: set of permissible values

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: value domain identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: identifier that allows unambiguous reference to a value set

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: separable component of something else, organized by topic or functional area
