https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifier used to indicate the representational conformance of element with respect to the ISO IDMP standard(s) it is derived from

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has active moiety
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a substance directly to an active moiety

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has agent modification type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: indicates the kind of agent that caused the modification

annotations.example: chemical, enzymatic, immunological, organism, UV radiation

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has alternate material
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a material specification to a another material specification, material classifier or substance, that is allowed to be alternatively used when manufacturing the material

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has amount
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates something to an absolute or relative quantification of mass, volume or amount of substance

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has amount type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: indicates how a numeric amount is to be interpreted

annotations.example: Exact (the default, when not specified); Approximate; NLT; NMT

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has author
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: indicates the party responsible for the creation of a publication, document or research, including data

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has C-terminal modification
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a protein subunit to the modification made at the c-terminal of the protein

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has C-terminal modification identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a protein subunit to an identifier for the molecular fragment modified at the c-terminal of the protein based on the ISO 11238 Substance ID

annotations.example: UNII code, K3Z4F99H6 (UNII), Lysine (K)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has C-terminal modification name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a protein subunit to the name of the molecular fragment modified at the c-terminal of the protein

annotations.example: Glycinamid, Lysine

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has country of origin
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates something, such as source material, to the country from which it was harvested or sourced

annotations.example: NL, DE, FR, ES, US. This is in line with Table G1 of the Annex G of ISO/TS 19844:2018(E), and it is the largest collection of countries

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has daughter nuclide
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: indicates a nuclide produced as result of radioactive decay

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has defining molecular formula
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a substance to a formal specification of its molecular formula

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has defining molecular formula by moiety
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a substance to a formal specification of its molecular formula by moiety

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has defining molecular weight
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a substance to a formal specification of its molecular weight

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has defining stereochemistry
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: is classified by the relative spatial arrangement of atoms within molecules

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has defining structure
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: indicates any arrangement and/or organization of interrelated elements in a specification for a substance

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has five prime substance identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a nucleic acid subunit to the unique identifier of the five prime

annotations.example: JKUHT76541 (Artificial ID)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has five prime substance name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a nucleic acid subunit to the nucleotide present at the 5' terminal

annotations.example: Tymidine (T)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has granular molecular part
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a portion of a physical substance (or specification thereof) to one of the scattered molecular entities (atoms, ions or molecules) that the substance is composed of at the molecular level

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has granular part
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relation between a collective of granular things to its granular parts

annotations.example: A portion of water has granular part a water molecule.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has half life
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: for a single radioactive decay process, the time required for the activity to decrease to half its value by that process

annotations.example: 109,77 min (¹⁸F)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has InChI
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: links something, such as a molecular structure, to a specification for a linear, layered representation of a chemical structure

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has InChI Key
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: links something, such as a molecular structure, to a textual specification for a fixed length (25 characters) condensed digital representation of an InChI

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has ingredient
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a substance or product composition to an ingredient of that composition

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has interaction type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a target to a kind of interaction it has with a given substance

annotations.example: AGONIST, INDUCER, INHIBITOR, PARTIAL ANTAGONIST, SUBSTRATE, PRODUCT

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has isotope substitution type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: is classified by an isotope substitution classifier

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has linkage identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates an interconnection (linkage), registered as a fragment, to its unique substance identifier

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has linkage name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates an interconnection (linkage), registered as a fragment, to its registered name

annotations.example: Phosphothioate

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has material
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a material specification or material to a another material specification, material classifier or substance that the material is made of

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has material component type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a material component specification to the type of component used for the material component

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has maternal parent organism identified by
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates something, such as source material or a hybrid specification, to an identifier for a maternal organism

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has maternal parent organism named
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates something, such as source material or a hybrid specification, to a name of a maternal organism

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has modification
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a substance (or physical substance) that has undergone a modification to the corresponding modification method (or prior modification)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has modification agent
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a modification (or method) to an agent involved in that modification

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has modification moiety
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a structural modification of a substance to the moiety that is applied in the modification

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has modification role
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a modification (or method) to the function of the modification

annotations.example: antigen, linker, conjugate, inactivation, antigen priming, end-cap polymerization, sizing of Polysaccharide into Oligosaccharides, inactivation of antigen to reduce allergenicity

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has modification type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a modification to its type

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has modified molecular fragment
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a structural modification of a substance to the molecular fragments that are modified

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has moiety
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a substance directly to a moiety that defines it via a substance composition

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has moiety role
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a substance constituency to a role played by a moiety

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has molecular formula
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates an actual single substance to a formal specification of its molecular formula

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has molecular formula by moiety
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates an actual single substance to a formal specification of its molecular formula, where that substance has two or more moieties, specified such that the molecular formula of each moiety shall be described separated by a dot

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has molecular weight
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a substance to its molecular weight

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has molfile
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: links something, such as a molecular structure, to a specification for a widely used, non-linear chemical structure file format

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has N-terminal modification
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a protein subunit to the modification made at the n-terminal of the protein

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has N-terminal modification identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a protein subunit to an identifier for the molecular fragment modified at the n-terminal of the protein based on the ISO 11238 Substance ID

annotations.example: UNII code; SZB8301W42 (UNII)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has N-terminal modification name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a protein subunit to the name of the molecular fragment modified at the n-terminal of the protein

annotations.example: Pyroglutamic acid (pE), 3-Mercaptopropionic acid

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has nuclide name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: links a name or company code to the isotope it denotes

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has optical activity
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates an actual single substance to a formal specification of the ability of that substance to rotate the plane of vibration of polarized light to the right or left

annotations.example: (+/-), (+), (-), None, N/A, Unknown

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has parameter
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: assigns a parameter to something

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has parent nuclide
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: indicates a radionuclide from which the nuclide was created through radioactive decay

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has parent substance
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a substance to its parent substance

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has parent substance identified by
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates something, such as source material, to an identifier for a parent substance

annotations.example: The substance ID of Ginkgo biloba L., Leaf

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has parent substance named
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates something, such as source material, to a name for a parent substance

annotations.example: The parent substance of the Herbal Drug Ginkgo biloba, Leaf is the substance (fresh): Ginkgo biloba L., or Ginkgo biloba L. (Whole plant). The parent substance of Influenza A virus A/Christchurch/16/2010 (H1N1), NIB-74xp is Influenza A virus A/Christchurch/16/2010 (H1N1).

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has paternal parent organism identified by
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates something, such as source material or a hybrid specification, to an identifier for a paternal organism

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has paternal parent organism named
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates something, such as source material or a hybrid specification, to a name of a paternal organism

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has property substance identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: indicates the substance identifier of a substance upon which a defining property depends

annotations.example: Solubility in Water, the Substance ID for Water shall be specified.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has property substance name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: indicates the name used to identify a substance related to a defining property

annotations.example: cell surface antigens (the Substance ID for CD4 would be captured to defined CD4 positive cells)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has reference information
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specifies informative reference details that may include classification, additional relationships and target information (for active substances)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has reference quantity value range
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates something (an expression, formula, a quantity value range etc.) to a magnitude expressed as range of numbers together with their unit(s) of measure (if applicable) as reference

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has reference source document type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: indicates the type of document

annotations.example: Pharmacopoeial monograph, Regulatory submission, Journal article, Release specification, In-house specification, Text file

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has reference source type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: indicates the type of source in which the data elements were actually found

annotations.example: BP, ChemID (NLM), Ph.Eur., USP/NF, IND (Investigational New Drug), Recommended INN List, ITIS, JAN, Journal, JP, KEGG, Martindale, NDA, Personal Care Products Council (PCPC), PubChem, USAN, USP, Web Page, CAS Registry, FDA Global Substance Registration System (FDA GSRS), WHO Collaborating Centre for Drug Statistics Methodology (WHOCC), Chemical Book, Orange Book, Marketing Authorization Application (MAA), WHO/IUIS Allergen Nomenclature, UniProt, Plasma Master File, Homeopathic Pharmacopoeia

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has related substance
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates something, such as a substance relationship, to the specification for a substance, moiety, or organism, or to the corresponding matter, including a molecular entity or physical organism or substance that is the target of the relationship

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has related substance identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates something, such as an organism or substance relationship, to an identifier for that substance, moiety, organism, or corresponding matter

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has related substance name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates something, such as an organism or substance relationship, to a preferred term or primary name for that substance, moiety, organism or the corresponding matter

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has residue modified
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: describes the residue(s) in a substance that are modified by the modification

annotations.example: Lysine; non-specific modifications; Reducing end of Oligosaccharide; ε-amino, α-amino, guanidinyl, secondary amino, and hydroxyl groups (in decreasing order of reactivity) of amino acids residues of proteins.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has SMILES
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: links something, such as a molecular structure, to a specification for an unambiguous linear representation of chemical or molecular structures using ASCII characters

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has sequence attachment
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: provides an 'enriched' string, a document or image representing the sequence

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has specified identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates something, such as material or a physical substance, to an identifier or code for the specification for that material or substance

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has starting material identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a polymer starting material (monomer) to the unique identifier assigned to the monomer

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has starting material name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a polymer starting material (monomer) to its substance name

annotations.example: Ethylene Oxide; .BETA.-D-Glucopyranose; Propylene Oxide; .BETA.-L-Iduronic acid, Pyranose form; Deoxyguanosine 5’-Monophosphate; 5-N-acetyl-α-D-Neuraminic acid; Alpha.-D-Galactose

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has stereochemistry
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: is classified by the relative spatial arrangement of atoms within molecules

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has structural modification type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: classifies by the type of structural modification

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has structure
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: indicates any arrangement and/or organization of interrelated elements in an actual substance

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has subject substance
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a substance relationship to the substance, moiety, or physical substance that the relevant reference information is about

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has substance classification subtype
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: links a substance classifier to an element indicating a subordinate level of the classification scheme

annotations.example: NDF-RT Mechanism of Action (MOA) or Physiological Effect

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has substance classification type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: links a substance classifier to an element indicating the highest level of the classification scheme

annotations.example: 'lower' level in ATC

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has substance classifier domain
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: links a substance classifier to a classifier and code that specifies the domain associated with the substance classifier

annotations.example: Human pharmaceutical, human vaccine, animal drug, animal vaccine, food, food additive, colourant, pesticide, tobacco additive, flavour, excipient

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has substance name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: links a name or company code to the substance it denotes

annotations.example: Amoxicillin; Harpagophytum procumbens (Burch.) DC. ex Meisn., Root

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has substance name domain
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: links a substance name to a classifier that specifies when and for what purpose the name is to be used

annotations.example: Biologic, cosmetic, drug, food, medicine, dietary supplement, homeopathic, mineral, zoological, allergen, botanical, vegetable oil, bacterial

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has substance name type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: links a substance name to the classifier for that name

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has substance type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: links a substance to a classifier that describes the nature of the substance as described in and in accordance with ISO 11238 definitions

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has sugar identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: indicates the unique substance identifier for the sugar or sugar-like component that makes up the nucleotide

annotations.example: UNII code for ribose

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has sugar name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: indicates the name of the sugar or sugar-like component that makes up the nucleotide

annotations.example: Ribose, deoxyribose, 2,5-dihydroxy-morphilino

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has target identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: indicates the identifier for the target relation molecular entity upon which the substance acts

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has target name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specifies the name of the target molecular entity upon which the substance acts

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has target organism
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates something, such as a target, to the organism for which the active substance is targeted

annotations.example: Homo Sapiens, M. TB, HIV-1

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has target organism type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates something, such as a target, to a classifier for the organism for which the active substance is targeted

annotations.example: human, viral, bacterial, fungal, insect, helminth, malarial

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has target type
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: links a target to a classifier associated with that target of an active substance

annotations.example: The therapeutic target would be HIV-1 protease when ritonavir is used in HIV-related therapy. The metabolic target is Cyp 3A4 and ritonavir is an inhibitor of this target. Ritonavir is also an inhibitor of P-glycoprotein, a drug transporter. In many combination products ritonavir is used strictly to inhibit Cyp 3A4/5 and transporter enzymes.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has three prime substance identifier
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a nucleic acid subunit to the unique identifier of the three prime

annotations.example: JKUHT76541 (Artificial ID)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: has three prime substance name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a nucleic acid subunit to the nucleotide present at the 3' terminal

annotations.example: Thymine (T)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: identifies specification for
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates an identifier for a specification of something, such as a substance, to the actual material or physical substance

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: interconnects
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a linkage, bridge, or connecting element to something, such as a nucleic acid subunit, that it connects

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: is active moiety of
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a moiety to a substance for which it is the essential aspect, responsible for its pharmacological activity

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: is author of
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specifies a reference and/or document attributed to the party

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: is derived from organism fraction
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates source material to the specification for a fraction of a constituent of an individual living entity of anatomical origin of source material within an organism

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: is derived from organism identified by
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates source material to a unique identifier associated with the source material parent organism

annotations.example: The substance Ginkgo biloba L. Leaf has an Organism ID belonging to the Organism Ginkgo biloba L.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: is derived from organism named
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates source material to an accepted scientific name associated with the source material parent organism based on the organism taxonomy

annotations.example: Ginkgo biloba L.; Harpagophytum procumbens (Burch.) DC. ex Meisn.

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: is derived from organism of stage
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates source material to the developmental stage of an animal, plant, algae, fungi, insect or micro-organism from which the source material is derived

annotations.example: foetus, infant, juvenile, adult, senescent, leafing, pre-flowering, flowering, fruiting, mature development stage, mature animal

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: is derived from organism part
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates source material to the specification for a constituent of an individual living entity of anatomical origin of source material within an organism

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: is granular molecular part of
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: indicates something that a granular molecular element is included in

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: is granular part of
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: indicates something that a granular element is included in

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: is ingredient of
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates an ingredient to a substance or product composition that it is included in

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: is interconnected via
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates something, such as a nucleic acid subunit, to something that connects it to something else

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: is moiety of
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a moiety directly to a substance that it defines via a substance constituency

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: is moiety role in
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates something in a moiety role (which may be a substance) to a constituency it is part of

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: is parent substance of
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: relates a substance to a child/derived substance

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: is reference information for
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: links informative reference details that may include classification, additional relationships and target information (for active substances) to a substance (specification), moiety, or physical substance it describes

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: is related substance to
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: specifies something, possibly a target substance, moiety, or matter with which the source substance, moiety, or matter has some relationship

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: stereochemistry - square planar 2
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: stereochemistry classifier indicating a square planar molecular geometry where the Cahn-Ingold-Prelog (CIP) priority of the donor atom directly across from the priority 1 donor atom is 2

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: stereochemistry - square planar 3

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: stereochemistry - square planar 4

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: stereochemistry - tetrahedral

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: stereochemistry - trans

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: stereochemistry - unknown

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: substance name classifier - brand name

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: substance name classifier for a name for a specified homeopathic substance

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: substance name classifier - specified substance group 2 name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: substance name classifier for a name of a substance classified as a member of specified substance group 2

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: substance name classifier - specified substance group 3 name
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: substance name classifier for a name of a substance classified as a member of specified substance group 3

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: substance name classifier - systematic name

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code for an ingredient that is any additive added

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code for an ingredient that is the base of a preparation

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: ingredient role - PRSV
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code for a preservative, an ingredient added to delay the risk of the product's spoiling

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: ingredient role - STBL

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: null flavor ASKU
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code for a value for which information was sought but not found (e.g. patient was asked but did not know).

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: null flavor DER
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code for value for which no attempt has been made to encode the information correctly but the raw source information is represented (usually in hasOriginalText property)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: null flavor INV
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code for a value as represented in the instance that is not a member of the set of permitted data values in the constrained value domain of a variable

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: null flavor MSK
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code for a value for which there is information available but it has not been provided by the sender due to security, privacy or other reasons

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: null flavor NA
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code for a value for which no proper value is applicable in this context (e.g. last menstrual period for a male)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: null flavor NASK
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code for a value for which information has not been sought (e.g. patient was not asked)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: null flavor NAV
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code for a value for which information is not available at this time but it is expected that it would be available later

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: null flavor NI
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code for a value that is exceptional (missing, omitted, incomplete, improper)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: null flavor NINF
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code for a value that is part of a value domain including a negative infinity of numbers

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: null flavor OTH
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code for an actual value that is not a member of the set of permitted data values in the constrained value domain of a variable (e.g. concept not provided by required code system)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: null flavor PINF
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code for a value that is part of a value domain including a positive infinity of numbers

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: null flavor QS
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code for a value for which a specific quantity is not known, but is known to be non-zero and is not specified because it makes up the bulk of the material

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: null flavor TRC
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code for a value for which content is greater than zero, but too small to be quantified

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: null flavor UNC
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code for a value for which an actual value may exist, but it must be derived from the information provided (usually an expression is provided directly)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: null flavor UNK
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code for a value for which proper value is applicable, but not known

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: controlled vocabulary representing the enumeration for null flavor codes as specified in ISO 21090

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: object identifier for the null flavor enumeration

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: object identifier for the integrity check algorithm enumeration

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: object identifier for the coding rationale enumeration

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: object identifier for the entity name part type enumeration

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: object identifier for the update mode enumeration

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: update mode A
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code indicating that an item was (or is to be) added, having not been present immediately before

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: update mode AR
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code indicating that an item was (or is to be) either added or replaced

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: update mode D
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code indicating that an item item was (or is to be) removed (sometimes referred to as deleted)

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: update mode K
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code indicating that the item is part of the identifying information for the object that contains it

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: update mode N
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code indicating that there was (or is to be) no change to the item

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: update mode R
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code indicating that an item existed previously and has been (or is to be) revised

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: update mode U
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: code indicating that it is not specified whether or what kind of change has occurred to the item, or whether the item is present as a reference or identifying property

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: update mode enumeration
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: controlled vocabulary representing the enumeration for update mode codes as specified in ISO 21090

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: provisional

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: conformance to ISO level - conformant
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: compliance level indicating that the ontology element is conformant with the corresponding ISO class, property, datatype, or other individual, including but not limited to the way it is modeled, its naming, annotations, and relationships

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: conformance to ISO level - definitionally conformant
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: compliance level indicating that the ontology element is conformant with the corresponding ISO class, property, datatype, or other individual with respect to its definition and other annotations, but may not be conformant with respect to how it is named or otherwise modeled

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: conformance to ISO level - extension
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: compliance level indicating that the ontology element extends the existing ISO standard with a concept that is either implied by the specification or fills a gap that was not addressed in the standard

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: conformance to ISO level - model conformant
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: compliance level indicating that the ontology element is conformant with the corresponding ISO class, property, datatype, or other individual with respect to how it is modeled, but not necessarily with respect to all of its relationships

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: conformance to ISO level - name and annotation conformant
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: compliance level indicating that the ontology element is conformant with the corresponding ISO class, property, datatype, or other individual with respect to its name, definition and other annotations, but may not be conformant with respect to how it is modeled

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: conformance to ISO level - naming conformant
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: compliance level indicating that the ontology element is conformant with the corresponding ISO class, property, datatype, or other individual with respect to its name, and possibly other annotations, but not in terms of its definition or with respect to how it is modeled

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: conformance to ISO level - needs clarification
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: compliance level indicating that the ontology element is conformant with the ISO standard but indicates that the standard should be revised in some fashion for clarification purposes

https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.label: conformance to ISO level - non-conformant
https://spec.pistoiaalliance.org/idmp/on.definition: compliance level indicating that the ontology element is not conformant with the corresponding ISO class, property, datatype, or other individual
